episode.subject: blackspotted pufferfish being cleaned
episode.title: A little farther
episode.body:
I turned to see what he was doing under my fin. He told me to hold still.

I said I would if he stopped making that little scraping feeling.

He said that was what I had come for.

I remembered coming over here. I had been very certain about wanting it done.

I asked whether he was nearly finished. He said nearly.

He had barely started.

I held the fin out a little farther.

proposals.visibleScene: Blackspotted puffer over branching coral, pectoral fin extended. A small blue-and-black striped cleaner fish is visible against the region under that fin. Main fish, raised fin and smaller fish are legible. Strong underwater blue cast; no parasites visible.
proposals.fictionBoundary: Dialogue, request for cleaning, turning, felt scraping, timing of reassurance and extending the fin farther are fiction. Observer explicitly records getting cleaned. No exact cleaner species, infection, injury, fin damage or treatment result is claimed.
proposals.continuity: Append after existing Rollo arc. Preserve blackspotted puffer Arothron nigropunctatus, home near Lizard Island, established voice and avatar. Source is Taveuni Island, Fiji, a compatible Indo-Pacific species illustration rather than a claim that Rollo relocated. Existing held cleaner passages remain verbatim and unbound. This interaction is about knowingly accepting reassurance and cooperating, distinct from the admitted self-scratching embarrassment and shadow experiment.
proposals.authorReview: Both participants and the particular fin location are present. Rollo first tries to stop the unpleasant part of something he wanted, remembers why he came, then recognizes a small comforting exaggeration and offers more access. No generic medical advice or lesson is appended. The visual blue cast and partly concealed cleaner remain lead review considerations.
